intro: Convert US cups to tablespoons (tbsp) instantly for baking, butter sticks, spice rubs, and liquid recipe scaling. Because 1 US customary cup equals 8 US fluid ounces and 1 tablespoon equals 1/2 fluid ounce, there are exactly 16 tablespoons in 1 US cup. Multiply your cup quantity by 16 above—or look up fractions and batch volumes from 0.04 cup to 64 cups below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. Metric & Australian Tablespoons
items: A US tablespoon equals 14.78676 mL (commonly rounded to 15 mL or 15 cc) with 16 tbsp per 236.59 mL US cup. An Australian tablespoon is 20 mL (12.5 tbsp per 250 mL metric cup).
Exact thirds do not divide evenly into whole tablespoons: 1/3 cup = 5 tbsp + 1 tsp (5.3333 tbsp), and 2/3 cup = 10 tbsp + 2 tsp (10.6667 tbsp).

faqs.question: How many cups is 6 tablespoons?
faqs.answer: 6 US tablespoons equals 3/8 of a cup, or 0.375 cups (6 ÷ 16 = 0.375).

faqs.question: How many tablespoons (spoons) are in half a cup?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 8 tablespoons (or 24 teaspoons) in 1/2 US cup (0.5 × 16 = 8 tbsp).

faqs.question: One eighth of a cup (1/8 cup) is how many tablespoons?
faqs.answer: One eighth of a US cup (0.125 cup) equals exactly 2 tablespoons (0.125 × 16 = 2 tbsp).

faqs.question: How many CCs (mL) are in a tablespoon?
faqs.answer: One US tablespoon equals 14.78676 cubic centimeters (cc or mL)—commonly rounded to 15 cc (15 mL) in cooking and medical dosing.
